code='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(n) for c in range(n) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    out = []
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        row = []
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            sr = 31 - r
            if 0 <= sr < n and grid[sr][c] != 8:
                v = grid[sr][c]
            else:
                sc = 31 - c
                if 0 <= sc < n and grid[r][sc] != 8:
                    v = grid[r][sc]
                else:
                    v = grid[c][r]
            row.append(v)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
path.write_text(code)
exec(code)
out=transform(grid)
print(out)
